subject: MAP draft & target close alignment — FinTechCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (FinTechCo)

Hi Samantha & Tom —

Great to talk earlier today — thanks for walking through the high-level goals and the rollout constraints. Per our conversation, attached is draft v1 of the Mutual Action Plan (FinTechCo_MAP_v1.docx) and an initial SOW stub (SOW_draft_20260224.pdf). Key takeaways below and a proposed milestone plan — please review and confirm or suggest changes.

Summary of discovery
- Primary use case: customer support triage and response generation for payment disputes (English, US).
- Expected Q2 volume: ~1.2M tokens/day peak; initial pilot 2 teams (~10 agents).
- Must support SSO (Okta), basic audit logs, and option for private deployment later.

Proposed MAP (high level)
- Milestone 1 — Contract & PO: draft contract shared 2026-02-24 (attached) -> target signature: 2026-03-15 (owner: Procurement/FinTechCo; Redwood: Marissa)
- Milestone 2 — Security & Compliance review: SOC2 docs + evidence by 2026-03-01 (owner: FinTechCo; Redwood: Rishi)
- Milestone 3 — SSO integration (Okta): SP metadata exchange + test plan by 2026-03-12 (owner: FinTechCo IT; Redwood: Rishi)
- Milestone 4 — Pilot kickoff (hosted API): 2026-03-18 (owner: FinTechCo Product; Redwood: Logan)
- Milestone 5 — Full rollout & SLA activation: target 2026-04-15 (owner: FinTechCo Ops; Redwood: Delivery)

Dependencies & notes
- Procurement timeline: we suggested target close 2026-03-20 during the call; please confirm whether procurement needs an earlier signature to meet internal fiscal or vendor onboarding cutoffs.
- SSO (Okta) is a hard dependency for pilot in your Prod environment — if that slips, we recommend an interim hosted pilot with roll-forward to private deployment.

Next steps
1) Can you confirm the procurement signature deadline and whether 2026-03-15 is acceptable?
2) Rishi, can you validate the SOC2 evidence checklist and SSO timeline?
3) If ok, Marissa will update the MAP doc and HubSpot deal notes and schedule a follow-up for final alignment.

Thanks — attaching the MAP draft and SOW for redlines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: FinTechCo_MAP_v1.docx, SOW_draft_20260224.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@fintechco.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (FinTechCo)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. A few alignment items from our side after internal check: 

Procurement & legal timeline
- Procurement has said they need the final contract by 2026-03-10 to get the vendor onboarding completed for our March vendor intake window. That means signatures need to be in by 2026-03-15 to avoid delaying the pilot.
- Legal has a one-week review for redlines; they prefer to receive the final SOW/contract by 2026-03-08.

SSO / Technical
- IT (Tom) confirms Okta is standard; we will need SP metadata and a test account. Estimated time for IT to complete on our side: 1 week from receiving metadata. We can prioritize this if we have clear dates.

Questions
1) Is Redwood able to commit to a contract signature target of 2026-03-15?
2) If procurement needs the vendor setup completed by 2026-03-10, are there any Redwood pre-onboarding items we should complete earlier to avoid delays?

I will loop in Procurement on any redlines. Happy to hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Product Operations Lead | FinTechCo
samantha.lee@fintechco.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (FinTechCo) — tech notes

Marissa / Logan — quick technical follow-up after the call and the MAP draft: 

SSO (Okta) workstreams
- Redwood needs SP metadata and an Okta test org to validate SAML flow. On our side, engineering/infra estimate = 5 business days to implement and test once we have metadata + test account credentials.
- If FinTechCo can return metadata by 2026-03-03, we can hit the 2026-03-12 milestone for SSO test. Otherwise we should plan for a hosted pilot and schedule a private deployment migration window.

Security & compliance
- I reviewed the SOC2 checklist. Most items are covered; we will prepare the evidence bundle by 2026-03-01 as proposed. I'll attach a short tech checklist (tech-checklist-okta.xlsx) with required fields for IT.

Procurement / legal dependencies
- For procurement vendor onboarding (their 2026-03-10 cutoff), we can provide an initial vendor packet (W9, COI, sample contract) ASAP. Marissa — I recommend we send these docs to Procurement this week to avoid upstream delays.

Contingency
- Plan A: hit SSO + contract -> pilot 2026-03-18.
- Plan B: hosted API pilot on 2026-03-18, SSO migration in week of 2026-03-29.

I'll be available to join any procurement/legal calls if needed.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechco.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call recap + MAP draft (FinTechCo) — MAP updated (signature dates)

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clarity on procurement windows. I've updated the MAP to reflect the dates you called out and added a small contingency plan. Summary of updates below and actions required. Updated MAP v1.1 attached in Drive (link in HubSpot).

Updated milestones (clean)
- Contract final & send to Legal for redline: 2026-03-05 (owner: Redwood (Marissa))
- FinTechCo legal redline return: 2026-03-08 (owner: FinTechCo Legal)
- Final contract for Procurement submission: 2026-03-10 (owner: Redwood + FinTechCo Procurement)
- Contract signature target: 2026-03-15 (owner: FinTechCo / Redwood)
- SSO test window (if metadata by 3/03): 2026-03-12 (owner: FinTechCo IT / Redwood SE)
- Pilot (hosted or hybrid) kickoff: 2026-03-18

Responsibilities & owners (high level)
- Redwood: provide vendor packet (W9/COI), finalize contract, prepare SOC2 evidence bundle, deliver SP metadata if needed. (Action: Marissa to upload vendor packet by 2026-02-28)
- FinTechCo: legal review & redlines, procurement submission, IT to provide Okta metadata and test account. (Action: Samantha/Tom to confirm metadata delivery by 2026-03-03)

Dependencies
- Vendor onboarding window 2026-03-10 is critical for not delaying pilot.
- If metadata delivery slips, we will run Plan B (hosted pilot on 2026-03-18) and schedule SSO migration thereafter.

Action items (please confirm by EOD 2026-02-28)
1) Samantha/Procurement: confirm the 2026-03-10 vendor submission and 2026-03-15 signature target.
2) Tom/IT: confirm you can return Okta metadata by 2026-03-03.
3) Rishi/Redwood SE: confirm SOC2 evidence bundle delivery on 2026-03-01 and vendor packet by 2026-02-28.

I'll update HubSpot and upload the MAP v1.1 + SOW draft and send the vendor packet today. If helpful, I can schedule a 15-min alignment call tomorrow.

Thanks all — looking forward to locking dates.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
